source_note: Hand-authored — the list of skills and their core actions is fixed by the rules and doesn't grow the way spell/feat lists do.

Acrobatics.description: Balance, tumble, maneuver, and perform agile physical actions.

Balance.description: Move across a narrow or uneven surface.

Maneuver in Flight.description: Perform a difficult maneuver while flying.

Squeeze.description: Move through a space narrower than your body.

Grab an Edge.description: Catch yourself when falling next to a surface.

Arcana.description: Knowledge of arcane magic, theory, and creatures.

Recall Knowledge (Arcana).description: Recall lore about arcane topics, creatures, or magic items.

Identify Magic.description: Determine the properties of a magic item or effect using arcane theory.

Learn a Spell.description: Add an arcane tradition spell to your repertoire/spellbook.

Decipher Writing.description: Interpret unclear or archaic arcane writing.

Athletics.description: Climb, swim, jump, grapple, shove, trip, and perform feats of strength.

Climb.description: Ascend or descend a slope or surface.

Force Open.description: Break open a stuck, locked, or barred door/object.

High Jump.description: Jump vertically, requires a Long Jump-style approach.

Disarm.description: Attempt to knock an item out of a creature's grip.

Crafting.description: Craft objects, identify items via inspection, and repair equipment.

Craft.description: Create an item over time using raw materials.

Identify Alchemy.description: Determine the properties of an alchemical item.

Recall Knowledge (Crafting).description: Recall lore about construction, alchemy, or engineering.

Deception.description: Lie, disguise, feint, and mislead others.

Create a Diversion.description: Distract a creature to become hidden or slip away.

Impersonate.description: Disguise yourself as someone else or a type of creature.

Lie.description: Convince someone that a falsehood is true.

Feint.description: Trick a foe in melee to make them off-guard against your next attack.

Diplomacy.description: Persuade and build rapport with others.

Gather Information.description: Ask around to learn about a subject.

Make an Impression.description: Improve a creature's attitude toward you.

Request.description: Ask a creature for aid or a favor.

Coerce.description: Force someone to act via threats.

Demoralize.description: Frighten a foe, making it frightened 1.

Administer First Aid.description: Stabilize a dying creature or restore some HP to a wounded one.

Treat Wounds.description: Restore Hit Points to a wounded creature outside combat.

Recall Knowledge (Medicine).description: Recall lore about diseases, poisons, or anatomy.

Nature.description: Knowledge of animals, plants, and primal magic.

Recall Knowledge (Nature).description: Recall lore about natural creatures, plants, or primal magic.

Identify Magic (Primal).description: Determine the properties of a primal magic item or effect.

Learn a Spell (Primal).description: Add a primal tradition spell to your repertoire.

Command an Animal.description: Direct a trained animal companion or mount to act.

Occultism.description: Knowledge of occult magic, esoteric phenomena, and cursed or unusual lore.

Recall Knowledge (Occultism).description: Recall lore about occult creatures, ancient mysteries, or occult magic.

Identify Magic (Occult).description: Determine the properties of an occult magic item or effect.

Learn a Spell (Occult).description: Add an occult tradition spell to your repertoire.

Performance.description: Impress with music, acting, dance, or oratory.

Perform.description: Put on a show for an audience, often to earn income or influence attitude.

Religion.description: Knowledge of deities, divine magic, and undeath.

Recall Knowledge (Religion).description: Recall lore about deities, divine magic, or undead creatures.

Identify Magic (Divine).description: Determine the properties of a divine magic item or effect.

Learn a Spell (Divine).description: Add a divine tradition spell to your repertoire.

Society.description: Knowledge of civilizations, laws, and social structures; navigating settlements.

Recall Knowledge (Society).description: Recall lore about local history, government, or culture.

Subsist.description: Scrape by in an urban environment for food and shelter.

Sneak.description: Move stealthily while staying hidden or undetected.

Hide.description: Become hidden from creatures that could otherwise see you, given cover or concealment.

Conceal an Object.description: Hide a held or worn object from view.

Survival.description: Track, navigate, and survive in the wilderness.

Sense Direction.description: Get your bearings in an unfamiliar area.

Subsist (Wilderness).description: Forage for food and build shelter in the wild.

Thievery.description: Pick locks, disable devices, and steal.

Palm an Object.description: Take an object without being noticed.

Steal.description: Take a small object from someone without them noticing.

Pick a Lock.description: Open a lock without the key.

Lore.description: A specialized knowledge subcategory (e.g., 'Academia Lore', 'Warfare Lore') chosen at character creation or via feats/backgrounds.

Recall Knowledge (specific Lore).description: Recall specialized knowledge within your chosen Lore subject.

Lore.note: A character can have multiple Lore skills, each tracked and improved separately.

perception.note: Not a skill in PF2e — Perception is its own statistic, but functions like a skill for proficiency purposes and determines initiative by default.

Seek.description: Actively search for something in an area.

Sense Motive.description: Try to detect lies, disguises, or hidden intentions.
